_comment: Natural blue sapphire: gem corundum (aluminium oxide) coloured blue by iron and titanium, cut and polished. TRANSLUCENTTHICK, like Diamond_Brilliant: a gem is a solid body seen through, and the defining observable is absorption with depth (the blue deepens through the body) and a high IOR (1.77) that bends what is seen through it. Param-only: a gem has no albedo texture. The blue is transmission_color, because the Creator tint does not reach what is seen through (E2), so a see-through colour is its own article. Physically Based 'Sapphire' gives the colour, the IOR and transmission 1; its colour is taken as the see-through colour at a 2 cm path (transmission_depth, judgement, Diamond's), so a gem of a few millimetres reads a pale-to-mid blue and a thick body a deep one. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): hairline scratches (overlay 1, damage; scratches on a gem's facets), dust as a deposit (Phase10), fingerprints (a handled stone), gated by the Edges mask (facet borders; its B channel is the corner band meant for a deposit, its A the open faces meant for handling). Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: Sapphire_Natural_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.note: the entry's colour is also used as transmission_color: for a see-through gem it is the colour seen through it.

sources.why: transmission_depth 0.02 m, the path at which the entry's colour is reached (as Diamond_Brilliant): a gem's own scale, so a stone of a few millimetres reads pale-to-mid blue. No measured absorption spectrum is carried; natural sapphires range from near-colourless to inky blue.
